activities.name: Hex: Attacks
activities.text: A creature within 30ft saves or has Disadvantage on attack rolls for 1 minute, repeating the save each turn.

activities.name: Hex: Saves
activities.text: A creature within 30ft saves or has Disadvantage on saving throws for 1 minute, repeating the save each turn.

activities.name: Hex: Checks
activities.text: A creature within 30ft saves or has Disadvantage on ability checks for 1 minute, repeating the save each turn.

activities.name: Hex Damage (1d6)
activities.text: The hexed creature takes necrotic damage at the start of each of its turns.

activities.name: Hex Damage (2d6)
activities.text: The hexed creature takes necrotic damage at the start of each of its turns.

activities.name: Hex Damage (3d6)
activities.text: The hexed creature takes necrotic damage at the start of each of its turns.

activities.name: Hex Damage (4d6)
activities.text: The hexed creature takes necrotic damage at the start of each of its turns.

activities.name: Hex Damage (5d6)
activities.text: The hexed creature takes necrotic damage at the start of each of its turns.

Hex (Wisdom)|Witch.why: Three curse choices plus damage tiers; free uses equal Wis mod per day.

activities.name: Cauldron Ritual
activities.text: Perform the night-long Cauldron ritual for a Wish-equivalent effect, always at a permanent cost.

Cauldron of the Ninth Moon|Witch.why: Story-gated ritual with no fixed frequency.

activities.name: Scribe's Insight
activities.text: As part of casting, swap one prepared spell for another of the same level from your spellbook.

activities.name: Arcane Recovery
activities.text: After 10 minutes of study, regain spell slots totalling up to half your Wizard level (rounded up), none above 5th.

activities.name: Detect Magic
activities.text: After 5 rounds of study, reveal the origin of an item's magic if you have met that kind before.

activities.name: Counterspell
activities.text: Against the spell's save DC as a reaction; on success a spell of up to half your Wizard level fizzles.

activities.name: First Signature Spell
activities.text: Cast your first signature spell at its level without expending a slot.

activities.name: Second Signature Spell
activities.text: Cast your second signature spell at its level without expending a slot.

Signature Spells|Wizard.why: Two spells each once per day; item uses (1) would block the second.

activities.name: Perfect Recall
activities.text: Make a DC 10 Intelligence check to recast a previously cast 1st-level spell (2nd-level from 24th) without spending a slot.
